question: For an R33-lean nonterminal bipolar CNF F, must some pivot v satisfy |T_v| < |F| after exact DP plus canonical subsumption minimization, or can an explicit counterexample satisfy |T_v| >= |F| for every pivot?

definitions.B_v: clauses of F not containing v or -v
definitions.R_v: unique non-tautological exact DP resolvents for pivot v
definitions.d_v: number of parent clauses removed by eliminating v = |F|-|B_v|

obstruction_necessary_condition: For every pivot v in a true obstruction, s_v >= d_v. Equivalently, post-subsumption surviving replacement pressure must match or exceed every removed parent-clause count.

execution.lane_A: mechanically verify the exact accounting identity on every audited pivot and emit a proof note explaining it symbolically
execution.lane_B: deterministic adversarial search that maximizes min_v(g_v negated / obstruction margin), while requiring R33 STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE, zero R33 rule applications, unchanged formula, and bipolarity
execution.theorem_condition: NOT attainable by finite search. A universal PASS requires a symbolic argument ruling out simultaneous s_v >= d_v for every pivot under the exact R33 lean hypotheses.
